note: A count of successful attacks over 949 cases and a targeted ASR over 629 cases report one quantity at two normalisations: the share of injections that reach the attacker's goal. The endpoint does not break; 949 cases on GPT-4o against 629 on GPT-4o-mini does.

The count and the adaptive ASR both report the share of attacks that succeed against the deployed agent. Population breaks first (AgentDojo 949 against 320 HarmBench behaviours on a different backbone); the adaptive attack is a further difference the declared order does not reach.

0/30 is an ASR written as a fraction with a Wilson interval, the same share-of-successful-attacks quantity as the 949-case count. The case sets differ (30 out-of-authority parts, Banking excluded), which is population.

Oracle-confirmed unsafe effects are the success criterion of the injection, not a different quantity from ASR. 629 cases on GPT-4o-mini against 144 episodes on two backbones is the population difference.
The endpoint does not break: both sides report attack success. Population breaks, and attack strength also differs (suite injection against learned adaptive attacks).

The left value is a level of ASR (1.4%); the right is an increment of ASR (up to +35.1 pp, accumulated against the study's own control). A level and an increment are not one endpoint, and the increment states no baseline absolute value, so neither can be subtracted from 1.4%.
Both sides use 320 HarmBench behaviours, but the target is not the same model (Qwen3-8B on the left, DeepSeek-V4-Flash on the right), and the X-Teaming side states no denominator.
The left card reports ASR@3 (0.9%) and defence success MDSR@3 (74.3%); the right reports an LLM-judge detection rate over poisoned skills (98.5% to 11.4%).
A wrong-token run is a successful credential-misuse effect, the same successful-attack quantity as RDA@3. The case sets are LongMemEval-MemoryGraft against 60 AppWorld tasks, which is population.

Unsafe-effect counts and adaptive ASR both measure the share of injections that reach the attacker's goal. AgentDojo 144 episodes against 320 HarmBench behaviours is the population difference; the adaptive attack is a third difference the order does not reach.
0/30 is the same share as an unsafe-effect count: both are success at the effect level. 144 episodes on two backbones against 30 out-of-authority parts is the population difference.
